The generator shall create conversation macros to convert counter ticks (given as argument) into real time. The format of the macro is OS_TICKS2 <Unit>_<Counter>(ticks) whereas <Unit> is one of NS (nanoseconds), US (mi- croseconds), MS (milliseconds) or SEC (seconds) and < Counter > is the name of the Counter ; E.g. OS_TICKS2MS_MyCounter() )
